title: Conway–Soifer covering conjecture for n = 3
abstract: Proves that ten congruent closed equilateral triangles covering a filled equilateral triangle of side three have common side at least one, with arbitrary positions, rotations and overlaps. Consequently ten unit triangles cannot cover a triangle of side 3 + ε for ε > 0. Includes reusable finite halfspace and ray-endpoint geometry, orientation-independent support and area bounds, and verified Bernstein polynomial interval checkers. Four derived contact cases and 100 kernel-checked certificates close the proof without a certificate hypothesis.

informal.ConwaySoifer.ten_triangle_cover_lower_bo: Any ten congruent closed equilateral triangles covering the filled equilateral target of side three have common side at least one. Positions, rotations and overlaps are unrestricted.
informal.ConwaySoifer.no_ten_unit_triangle_cover: For every ε > 0, ten closed equilateral triangles of side one cannot cover the filled equilateral target of side 3 + ε, regardless of position or rotation.
